{{Sexagenary cycle}}
'''Yang Metal Dragon also known as 庚辰''' (kanoetatsu, koukinnotatsu, koushin) is one of the elements of the {{ill|Sexagenary cycle|ja|六十干支|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Sexagenary cycle|ja_comment=fixed jawiki redirect|3=干支|1=Sexagenary cycle|comment=changed title based on wikidata|qid=Q246658}}.

It is the 17th combination of the {{ill|Sexagenary cycle|ja|六十干支|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Sexagenary cycle|ja_comment=fixed jawiki redirect|3=干支|1=Sexagenary cycle|comment=changed title based on wikidata|qid=Q246658}}, preceded by {{ill|Kibou|ja|己卯|1=Yin Earth Rabbit|2=ja|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Kibou|ja_comment=jawiki link invalid}} and followed by {{ill|Shinshi|ja|辛巳|1=Yin Metal Snake|2=ja|3=辛巳|4=zh|5=辛巳|6=ko|7=신사 (간지)|lt_ko=신사|8=fr|9=Serpent de métal|10=de|11=Metall-Schlange|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Shinshi}}. In the framework of {{ill|Yin Yang Five Elements Thought|ja|陰陽五行思想|1=Yin-Yang and Wuxing Theory|lt=Yin Yang Five Elements|lt_ja=陰陽五行|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Yin Yang Five Elements Thought}}, the {{ill|Heavenly Stems|en|Heavenly Stems|qid=Q1190985|lt=Heavenly Stems|1=Heavenly Stems}} symbol {{ill|Kou|ja|庚|1=Kanoe (庚)|lt=Kanoe (庚)|2=ja|3=庚|4=zh|5=庚|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Kou}} represents yang {{ill|Metal|ja|Metal (金)|1=Metal (wuxing)|lt=Metal (金)|2=es|3=Metal (Wu Xing)|4=it|5=Metallo (elemento)|6=vi|7=Kim (Ngũ hành)|8=tr|9=Metal (klasik element)|10=uk|11=Метал (У-сін)|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Metal|ja_comment=jawiki link invalid}}, while the {{ill|Earthly Branches|en|Earthly Branches|qid=Q1072961|lt=Earthly Branches|1=Earthly Branches}} symbol {{ill|Dragon|ja|辰|1=chén|lt=Dragon (辰)|2=ja|3=辰|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Dragon|comment=changed title based on wikidata|qid=Q16538966}} represents yang {{ill|Earth|ja|Earth (土)|zh|Earth (土)|comment=doing this to prevent wrong interwiki linking by bot|1=Earth (wuxing)|lt=Earth (土)|2=ru|3=Земля (у-син)|4=mn|5=Шороо (махбод)|6=uk|7=Земля (У-сін)|8=als|9=Ärde in dr chinesische Fümf-Elemänt-Leer|10=bcl|11=Daga (wuxing)|12=vi|13=Thổ (Ngũ hành)|ja_comment=jawiki link invalid}}, establishing a generating relationship ({{ill|Mutual Generation|ja|五行思想#相生（そうじょう）|lt=Mutual Generation|lt_ja=相生|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Mutual Generation|1=Wuxing (Chinese philosophy)|comment=changed title based on wikidata|qid=Q218652}}) (i.e. Earth generates Metal).

==Pronunciation==
* English: Yang Metal Dragon (庚辰)
** Chinese (Mandarin Pinyin): gēngchén
** Cantonese (Jyutping): gaang1 san4
** Japanese:
***Kunyomi 1: Kanoe-tatsu
***Kunyomi 2: koukin-no-tatsu
***Onyomi 1: koushin
** Korean (Revised Romanization, Hangul): gyeongjin (경진)
** Vietnamese (Hán-Việt): Canh Thìn

==Months of Yang Metal Dragon==
In a {{ill|Common Era|en|Common Era|qid=Q208141|lt=Common Era|1=Common Era}} year whose final digit is 0 or 5 (when the {{ill|Heavenly Stems|en|Heavenly Stems|qid=Q1190985|lt=Heavenly Stems|1=Heavenly Stems}} are {{ill|Kou|ja|庚|1=Kanoe (庚)|lt=Kanoe (庚)|2=ja|3=庚|4=zh|5=庚|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Kou}} or {{ill|Otsu|ja|乙|1=Kinoto (乙)|lt=Kinoto (乙)|2=ja|3=乙|4=zh|5=乙|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Otsu}}), the month of {{ill|March|en|March|qid=Q110|lt=March|1=March}} is designated as the {{ill|Month|en|Month|qid=Q5151|lt=month (calendar)|1=Month}} of {{ill|Koushin|ja|庚辰|1=Yang Metal Dragon|2=ja|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Koushin|ja_comment=jawiki link invalid}}. However, here the term "month" may refer either to the month of the {{ill|Lunisolar|ja|旧暦|1=Japanese Lunisolar Calendar|11=Japanese Lunisolar Calendar|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Lunisolar}} or to the seasonal month (from {{ill|Qingming (solar term)|en|Qingming (solar term)|qid=Q1680269|lt=Qingming|1=Qingming (solar term)}} until the day before {{ill|Lixia|en|Lixia|qid=Q1191007|lt=Lixia|1=Lixia}}) as applicable.

==Days of Yang Metal Dragon==
* {{ill|Emperor Jimmu|en|Emperor Jimmu|qid=Q200188|lt=Emperor Jimmu|1=Emperor Jimmu}} (the founder and first {{ill|Emperor of Japan|en|Emperor of Japan|qid=Q208233|lt=Emperor|1=Emperor of Japan}} of {{ill|Japan|en|Japan|qid=Q17|lt=Japan|1=Japan}})'s birthday.

=== Selected Day (選日) ===
The day of {{ill|Koushin|ja|庚辰|1=Yang Metal Dragon|2=ja|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Koushin|ja_comment=jawiki link invalid}} is the 3rd day of {{ill|Hando|ja|犯土|lt=Small Earth|lt_ja=小土|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Hando|1=Tsuchi (Japanese term)|comment=changed title based on wikidata|qid=Q11571306}}.
